## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Muṭṭhipūjakattheraapadāna* is a biographical poem preserved in the *Therāpadāna* collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. While no English translation title is recorded on SuttaCentral, the text has been translated into five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
Textual analysis conducted by DharmaNexus reveals substantial Pali-internal text reuse, prominently with the first volume of the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo), which shares 23 matching passages (longest §3.1–4.4) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, the text shares stock poetic and narrative segments with several other verses in the *Therāpadāna*, including the *Desapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 166; §4.2–7.1), the *Atthasandassakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 139; §3.1–5.3), the *Āsanupaṭṭhāhakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 110), the *Kakkārupupphapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 156), the *Mandāravapupphapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 157), and the *Bodhiupaṭṭhākattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 188) [DharmaNexus]. In automated cross-language searches, DharmaNexus also identifies alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-avalokana-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra* (D0195; e.g. §1.2 ↔ §261b-13), though this alignment is not listed as a curated parallel on SuttaCentral [DharmaNexus; SuttaCentral].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
